parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The name of the vServer group.

parameters.name: IncludeListener
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return information about the associated listeners. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes
*   **false** (default): no

parameters.name: IncludeRule
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the forwarding rules associated with the vServer groups. Valid values:

*   **true**: yes
*   **false** (default): no

parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the CLB instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun slb describe-vserver-groups --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1o94dp5i6ea0000000 --include-rule false --include-listener false --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --description Group3 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun slb DescribeVServerGroups --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Description Group3 --IncludeListener false --Tag.1.Value TestValue --LoadBalancerId 'lb-bp1o94dp5i6ea0000000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --IncludeRule false
